The Indian Maritime University is expected to announce IMU CET Result 2026 by second week of June 2026 at its official website, imu.edu.in. The computer-based test was conducted on 24th May 2026, with approximately 25,000 candidates. As the results have been announced, candidates can now check and download their online scorecards by simply visiting the official website and logging in using their respective application number and password as login credentials. They can also access their IMU CET result 2026 by simply clicking on the direct link shared below. Along with the CET results, the university will also release the rank list and merit list in the form of an online PDF.

IMU CET Result 2026

The Indian Maritime University Common Entrance Test is a national exam conducted by the Indian Maritime University for candidates willing to take admissions into undergraduate (like B.Tech Marine Engineering, B.Sc Nautical Science), postgraduate, and diploma maritime programs. The exam was successfully held on 24th May 2026, and after successful completion of exams, candidates are now eagerly waiting for outcome of their hard work. So this is to inform them that IMU CET results are expected to be announced by the second week of June 2026 in PDF format on the official website imu.edu.in. Candidates can check their names, roll numbers and ranks directly. With results announced, qualified candidates will be considered eligible for counseling and admission procedures.

IMU CET Merit List PDF Download Link

The IMU CET Merit List PDF Download Link allows candidates to access the list of qualified students based on their CET scores. The merit list will be released in PDF format and contain important details like candidate’s name, roll number, category, rank and overall marks. Candidates are informed about the release of the result and merit list via an official Email or SMS sent to their registered mobile number or email ID. The merit list is essential for candidates to know their position and eligibility for the online counselling process.

imu.edu.in CET Result 2026 Link

Once the online IMU CET merit list and rank list are updated by the Indian Maritime University at its official website, candidates must make sure they carefully go through all the details mentioned there. How to Download IMU CET 2026 Result PDF?

To check IMU CET 2026 Result, candidates are required to follow simple step-by-step process shared below. The result will be available in PDF format and must be preserved for further admission procedures. Step 1: firstly, visit official Indian Maritime University website. Step 2: Search for IMU CET Result 2026 PDF download link and click on it. Step 3: Page will be redirected to the login window. Step 4: Carefully enter your respective application number, password/date of birth and security pin. Step 5: Once the details are filled successfully, click on the ‘submit’ option. Step 6: Check all the details mentioned on the CET score cards. Step 7: Download your IMU CET Result 2026 PDF and keep it safe until completion of admission process.

Q1. What is IMU CET Result Date 2026?

Answer: IMU CET Result 2026 is expected to be announced by second week of June 2026.

Q2. Will I require any login details to access my IMU CET Merit List 2026?

Answer: Yes, to check and download IMU CET Merit List 2026 PDF candidates are required to enter their application number and passwords as login details.

Q3. Where will IMU CET Result 2026 PDF download link be available?

Answer: IMU CET Result PDF download link will be activated at the official website imu.edu.in.
